pitch_routes.genre: All genres incl. factual, factual entertainment, true crime, docs
pitch_routes.route: Email the idea to submissions@uktv.co.uk; proposals 1-2 pages; indies only (no individuals); include trigger-warning content notes in the email body per Film and TV Charity guidance; four-week response target. If no reply after four weeks, chase via niamh.claydon-mullins@uktv.co.uk (published on the commissioning page as the contact who flags ideas to the relevant team member). No commissioning rounds, no preferred-supplier list, no tariff.

briefs.title: Factual & Factual Entertainment for U
briefs.summary: Well-known talent immersed in worlds they're passionate about (incl. funny factual - Will & Ralf, Pete Wicks, Guy Martin, Robson Green, Dom Chinea); NOT social purpose, NOT reality.

briefs.title: True crime for U
briefs.summary: Wants U to be a true crime destination: well-known UK stories with name recognition, new way in/perspective, survivor point of view, treated sensitively; open to co-pros/co-commissions with international broadcasters; talent-led crime-adjacent projects and 'noisy' docs welcome; NOT blue-light formats (already has Special Ops: To Catch A Criminal).

briefs.title: Cars / motoring for U&Yesterday
briefs.summary: Next big repeatable, returnable classic-car format in new precincts with warm, relatable UK characters; nostalgia-led; closed episodes with a reveal plus a reason to return.

briefs.title: Documentaries for U
briefs.summary: Unmissable, statement docs with high-profile talent who bring authorship and vulnerability (e.g. Stacey Dooley Sleeps Over); single docs if editorially justified (e.g. Becoming Victoria Wood); NOT social purpose.
